UPDATE alert_rules
        SET name = $2, channel = $3, pattern = $4, match_mode = $5,
            case_insensitive = $6, cooldown_secs = $7, enabled = $8, take_screenshot = $9,
            metric = $10, comparator = $11, threshold = $12, duration_secs = $13, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
